## Summary

Describe the user or maintainer problem and the changes made.

## Evidence and scope

- [ ] This is a fix for a reported issue (link it below).
- [ ] This is a new feature with an agreed issue/scope (link it below).
- [ ] Claims in documentation match implemented behavior; no adoption, security, or integration claims are invented.

## Verification

List commands and results. Be specific about what was not tested.

- [ ] `npm run lint`

## Security and operations

- [ ] No credentials or private user data are included.
- [ ] Relevant security, privacy, permissions, and operational limitations are documented.
